observation: Git add normalized one CRLF sequence in each frozen archived Markdown file, changing recorded byte hashes.
firstCorrectionAttempt: Adding exact-path attributes and ordinary git add did not refresh already-indexed unchanged files; explicit byte equality assertion failed before any commit.
decision: Exact-path -text attributes plus targeted git add --renormalize retain original bytes. cr-at-eol recognizes preserved CRLF while ordinary trailing-space/space-before-tab and unchanged credential hook remain active. No source bytes or prior recorded hashes changed.
